requirements.requirement: The system must include a proximity object in each clinical trial returned by evaluate_care_facade when proximity data is available.
The system must map distance_miles, duration_minutes, and normalized_score fields from clinical_trials_service into the facade response without renaming.
The system must preserve all existing clinical trial response fields when adding proximity data.
The system must ensure proximity normalized_score values are returned as integers between 0 and 100 inclusive.
The system must include proximity metadata fields (route_source and timestamp) in the facade response when present in the upstream model.
The system must ensure tool_router returns clinical trial objects containing the proximity field without additional transformation loss.
The system must serialize proximity data into a JSON-compatible structure suitable for frontend consumption.
The system must omit the proximity field from a trial response when proximity data is not computed rather than returning null or partial objects.
The system must handle missing user location by returning clinical trials without proximity data and without raising an exception.
The system must handle upstream service failure (clinical_trials_service error) by returning clinical trials without proximity data while preserving core trial results.
The system must ensure that proximity data is aligned to the correct trial record and not mismatched across trials.
The system must maintain response latency within acceptable bounds by not performing additional synchronous external calls within evaluate_care_facade.
